# Client Kit

> Client Kit is a web tool for freelancers. You send one link. Your client reads the proposal, e-signs it, and pays you directly by UPI or your own payment link (Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay). Client Kit takes no cut of job payments.

Client Kit is built by Adarsh Sharma, a solo founder in India.

## What it does

- Proposal: scope, line items, an advance of 0, 30, 40 or 50 percent, an optional revision limit, expiry.
- Signature: a simple electronic signature (legal name, intent checkbox, IP, time, document hash). It is not Aadhaar eSign and not a digital signature certificate.
- Payment: the client pays your UPI VPA (with a QR code) or opens your own hosted payment link. The money never passes through Client Kit.
- The client does not create an account. The link can be shared on WhatsApp.

## What it does not do

No invoicing, time tracking, escrow, CRM or pipeline, calendar booking, client portal, team seats, or white-label.

## Pricing

- Free: 3 sent jobs a month, never expires.
- Founder: $9 a month, 20 sent jobs a month, first 50 workspaces only.
- Solo: $12 a month, 40 sent jobs a month.
- Busy: $29 a month, unlimited sent jobs.
- India pricing is in INR.
